page.overview:
What is Gouging Fire?

Gouging Fire greatly resembles Entei except its large head crest resembled a frill of a , notability Styracosaurus. It still bears gray paws with brown pads, but its front paws have sharp red claws extended outward and three green stripes are on its right thigh. It's gray plate still covers its muzzle and resembles a handlebar mustache.

Instead of black cuff-like bands around all four legs, there is only two on the back legs while the front legs each have two black pads on them. A long, light gray cloud of smoke now forms the 'tail' of Gouging Fire. Gray plating is still visible on its back compared to its cream underbelly.

According to A.I. Sada, Gouging Fire was believed to be an Entei that was resurrected from a fossil.

Via its signature move, Burning Bulwark, it can set its fur ablaze as a defensive mechanism. Much like Entei, it has control over volcanos and fire, able to summon flaming pillars and cause eruptions by roaring.
